description: List this account's spend budgets with their current-cycle status (spend so far, projected total, ok/warning/exceeded state, and forecast state). Mirrors GET /api/accounts/:accountId/budgets. A budget carries its own `currency` (budgets are NOT converted to the USD base the cost tools return), and `amount_cents` is denominated in it; `spend_cents`/`projected_cents` are in `status_currency`, the budget's currency as of the rollup that wrote them. Never quote any of these figures as dollars without checking those two fields.
name: list_budgets
